subject: Next steps: locking a demo window + security & procurement intro
messages: From: Aisha Rahman To: Ana Gomez Cc: Sean Gallagher Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700 Subject: Next steps: locking a demo window + security & procurement intro Hi Ana — Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: - Goal: 45–60 minute technical demo focused on inference latency, data controls, and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated). - Ideal attendees: platform lead, security contact, procurement. You mentioned Miguel (platform) and a procurement point. - Success criteria: verify SSO/SAML options, confirm data retention controls, and surface rough TCO for 100k tokens/day. Proposed demo windows (PST): - Wed Aug 28, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00 - Thu Aug 29, 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00 Can you confirm which of the above works, and please loop in the procurement + security contacts you want on the call? I can send a calendar invite and a short mutual action plan. I’m attaching the security checklist you asked for and a one-page mutual action plan so procurement has visibility (attached: novapulse-security-reqs.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx). Thanks — Aisha Account Executive | Redwood Inference aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0126 --- Attachment: novapulse-security-reqs.pdf (summary checklist, 2 pages) Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub: milestone dates + owners) From: Ana Gomez To: Aisha Rahman Cc: Miguel Torres , Novapulse Procurement Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:48:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Next steps: locking a demo window + security & procurement intro Aisha — Appreciate the clear recap. Both Miguel and our procurement inbox are looped here. A couple notes: - Miguel (platform) can do Thu Aug 29 at 16:00–17:00 PT. He prefers later in the day. - Procurement asked if we can get a one-page T&C or draft SOW outline ahead of the call; they just want to understand procurement path and timelines. - Security would like to review the checklist you attached and ask for an SOC2 summary or auditor name if possible. If you can send an invite for Thu 8/29 16:00 PT and include a short agenda and the Miro/slide link, we’ll confirm internally. Thanks, Ana Director, Cloud Platform Novapulse --- Attachment: (none in reply) From: Aisha Rahman To: Ana Gomez Cc: Miguel Torres , Novapulse Procurement , Kimberly Park , Sean Gallagher Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Next steps: locking a demo window + security & procurement intro Thanks Ana — looping in our security lead, Kimberly Park, and sales engineer Sean so we have the right folks on the call. Kimberly: brief intro — Novapulse is evaluating an inference path for customer-facing recommendation scoring and wants to validate latency and data controls. Procurement is asking for a short SOW/T&C outline; I’ve attached the mutual action plan again with milestone dates. Sean: I’ve penciled Thu Aug 29 16:00–17:00 PT. Can you lead the demo (runtime performance, batching strategy) and prepare a one-slide TCO example for ~100k tokens/day? Kimberly: can you surface our SOC2 summary and any one-page security artifacts we typically share? Procurement would prefer to see auditor name + retention controls ahead of the pilot decision. Agenda for 8/29 (draft): - 5m intros & objectives (Aisha) - 25m demo: runtime, latency, quantization tradeoffs (Sean) - 15m security controls & data handling (Kimberly) - 10m procurement path & next milestones (Aisha + procurement) I’ll send the calendar invite and include the attachments and a short hubspot note (HS-12345). Best, Aisha --- Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (re-sent) From: Miguel Torres To: Aisha Rahman , Kimberly Park , Sean Gallagher , Novapulse Procurement , Ana Gomez Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Next steps: locking a demo window + security & procurement intro Thanks all — confirmed for Thu 8/29 16:00–17:00 PT. Invite accepted. A few quick asks from platform: - Please include a short section on SSO/SAML flow and whether we can self-host the private deployment (we’ll want to understand network egress). - Procurement: Miguel copied procurement for any contract timing questions; we’d like an initial read on typical pilot length and cancellation points. Aisha — please share the SOC2 auditor name and a redacted SOC2 summary before the call if possible. Also, can you attach the one-slide TCO to the calendar invite? See you Thursday, Miguel Senior Engineering Manager, Platform Novapulse --- Attachment: novapulse-requested-scope.txt (customer note referencing docs they want)
